brief:
The Interior and National Security Ministry in Gaza reported that dozens were killed and wounded in a large-scale Israeli airstrike on the Katiba area west of Medina, according to Shehab Wire. The operation involved scores of warplanes conducting intensive strikes. The ministry characterized the assault as a new crime committed by Israeli occupation forces.

The strike targeted a location where Moeen al-Aranbeed, a figure known locally as a "spy hunter," had previously been abducted during an earlier operation. Details of his status following the fresh airstrike were not immediately clear from available reporting.
